JACKSONVILLE, Fla.


, Sept. 8, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Fidelity National Financial, Inc. (NYSE: FNF) (FNF), today announced that Mike Nolan, Chief Executive Officer, and Tony Park, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Barclays Global Financial Services Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at approximately 2:45 pm Eastern Time.


The fireside chat will be available live and for replay via audio webcast on[investor.fnf.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767005-1&h=107500082&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4555416-1%26h%3D1603362316%26u%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.investor.fnf.com%252F%26a%3Dinvestor.fnf.com&a=investor.fnf.com) .


**About Fidelity National Financial, Inc.**


Fidelity National Financial, Inc. (NYSE: FNF) is a leading provider of title insurance and transaction services to the real estate and mortgage industries, and a leading provider of insurance solutions serving retail annuity and life customers and institutional clients through its majority owned subsidiary F&G Annuities & Life, Inc. (NYSE: FG). FNF is the nation's largest title insurance company through its title insurance underwriters - Fidelity National Title, Chicago Title, Commonwealth Land Title, Alamo Title and National Title of New York - that collectively issue more title insurance policies than any other title company in the United States. More information about FNF can be found at[www.fnf.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767005-1&h=1710241118&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fnf.com%2F&a=www.fnf.com) .
